messages.label: PUBACK — the broker's word
messages.note: none in timeout → break link → Failed

messages.label: Ack(id, exit) — key matched

cards.title: Two words for done
items: PUBACK is the broker's word that it took the command — with no ack topic the receipt says exit: published
The ack on the ack topic is the device's own word: its id and its exit
Only a message whose key is the run's key counts as ours

cards.title: What a failure becomes
items: No PUBACK in the timeout: TimeoutError → Failed, no receipt, and the link is broken so nothing is ever re-sent
PUBACK but no ack: Failed, no receipt, link kept — the command was certainly taken
Broker absent: ConnectionError → Failed, nothing published

cards.title: Order on the wire
items: SUBSCRIBE for the ack topic precedes PUBLISH on one TCP session, so the subscription exists before the answer can arrive
Every wait is bounded and runs on a worker thread; the event loop is never blocked
A retry is a new act under the same key — the device can tell it from a second act
